commit_scope: Replace serial native Pulse serving and request admission with reusable Form/JIT readiness dispatch and checkpoint-verified concurrent views.

roles: native dispatch and coherent read source repair

evidence_refs: Kernel dependency PR 604 landed first at db25d1a2ab6ebab0c98b51c810eba2661b8d1f36. Reusable native-linux.bml emits one Linux syscall image; operation and pointer/scalar selection are data. native-socket-dispatch.bml owns readiness, private forked request contexts, output backpressure, PID completion and release. No C socket/poll/fork/server/application implementation was added. The existing CPU-image seed boundary was made available to explicitly tagged Linux x86-64 images; foreign and untagged ARM images remain refused on that ISA.

The focused Linux CPU image observation returned the actual PID, refused foreign/untagged images, distinguished ready/idle polling, transferred whole-native-packet, retained errno -11 and closed all owned sockets. The production GCC/bookworm build named and repaired two existing Linux bootstrap failures at source: early size_t before its header and the ARM64 admission tombstone reset referenced outside that carrier. No broad kernel suite or retired bootstrap comparison ran.

The first asynchronous file-task attempt removed archive serialization but health still took 1234 ms. It was retired before landing. The replacement retains admitted cells and native request values through Form-JIT fork, with no request executable, spool/JSON bridge or nested read process. Its archive/document/health wave returned 200 throughout: health 73 ms total/48 ms serving, document 4013/4003 ms, full archive 19127/18589 ms. Exact captures remain private at /data/native-io/31-latency-trace in the rehearsal archive. This proves independent progress, not an all-green latency claim under a heavy archive workload.

The old read held the writer lock through complete history and HTML rendering. fp-coherent now offers a source version, observes its view in a native cell outside that lock, then waits out publication at the ending boundary. A crossed checkpoint re-enters the same read; stable source errors still surface. The focused native fixture forced a commit between view and verification, observed exactly two attempts and published the new one-sample checkpoint, not the crossed zero-sample view.

Pulse retains its existing JSON/HTML paths, CORS, interval semantics, complete disclosures, no-transform and script-free policy. FK_STORE_PRIVATE selects existing private allocation for values and program pages; disabling the global field alone was not sufficient for fork ownership. Durable history still belongs to the existing Recipe/checkpoint protocol. The rehearsal archive retains 6339890 samples. No thresholds, retention, histogram weights or response counts were relaxed. A native source lookup found the old wr-serve and wr-http-head only in their defining templates.bml; those unused serial listener helpers are retired.

Kernel follow-up PR 607 owns standalone framing imports, incremental Content-Length/chunk/trailer state and reusable native POSIX images. Linux x86-64 and Darwin ARM64 packet/framing observations passed; incomplete peers permit independent progress, ambiguous/malformed framing receives 400, a source stop 500, and the listener then 200. Completion pipes retire the Linux pidfd dependency. Three existing allocation selectors honor FK_STORE_PRIVATE; no C dispatch or protocol implementation was added. The earlier shared-page failure and failed aggregate observation remain failures in receipts/2026-10-19-native-framing-care.md, not passes.

Review 4312335225 was repaired at fp-coherent: a crossed source version resumes before interpreting either errors or stopped outcomes. The forced crossing fixture returned one stale error/stopped outcome, then observed exactly two attempts and the stable one-sample value.

Final private-context rehearsal after the framing/completion repair returned 200 for all three concurrent reads: health 75 ms total/55 ms serving, document 3998/3962 ms, complete archive 17855/17358 ms. The native private capture is /data/native-io/30-latency-trace. This is the current independent-progress evidence; earlier figures remain historical rather than substituted.

Minimal observations followed changed inputs. The first trace immediately after listener restart ran before native admission completed and returned transport status 0; it is not a pass. The admitted listener then completed the wave above. Exact original and attempted traces remain private. A temporary local source-reading helper reported an unresolved split-on prelude and was repaired to read exact byte spans; no implementation path was changed to hide it.

OpenAI frontier reasoning authored the movement; exact model/task tokens are not exposed. form-cli ask returned nothing=empty for the dispatch question. Native source lookup then found the existing Form-emitted Darwin syscall image and CPU-image door, which grounded the reusable Linux extension. No native generation share is claimed. Remaining web/ideas/vitality source latency stays active work after this landing.

local_validation.summary: Focused Linux RAM/ISA/socket observation, native publication-crossing fixture and independent-progress archive wave; no broad suites.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: Slow archive or peer I/O no longer serializes acceptance and health; read views publish only a verified checkpoint without holding the writer lock through rendering.
test_flows: Forced checkpoint crossing re-enters the read
